dict.string: Canopy uses ScreenCaptureKit to transcribe meeting audio from other apps when you choose Start listening. No screen video or audio recording is saved.
Canopy transcribes meeting audio from other apps on your Mac when you choose Start listening. No audio file is saved.
Canopy transcribes your microphone locally when you start a meeting. No audio file is saved.
Canopy uses on-device speech recognition to write your meeting transcript.
